_doc: REVIEWED manifest: maps each roadmap slice (capability.slice) to the canonical_capability domain(s) it delivers, with optional key-prefix allow/deny globs to split a shared domain across several slices. This is the ONE hand-curated artifact of the no-miss linker (link-slices.mjs Pass A). Linking is STATUS-ORTHOGONAL — a wrong edge can mis-attribute a cap to a slice but can NEVER flip its build status. Domains not claimed by any slice fall through to the per-domain backlog (visible in the cap-roadmap doc). Crate names here are the ROADMAP names; the canonical rows use census-era crate names, so we join on DOMAIN, not crate.

11.note: OSINT investigation core — owns the osint.* bulk

15.note: Observability trace timeline — owns obs.* bulk

19.note: Native ERP Core — owns erp.* (NOT the mis-clustered noise.* rows)

20.note: Product analytics — analytics caps not under obs.*

16.note: Knowledge base / dataset — owns agent-knowledge.* bulk

10.note: Internet Hand / Playwright — owns browser-internet-hand.* bulk

22.note: Media artifact pipeline — owns media.* bulk

21.note: Native Support Inbox — owns crm-support.* bulk

slices._multi_owner_note: Trading-markets and the long-tail simulation/debate/security slices share their domains; the keyPrefix splits above keep the dense domains (osint/obs/erp/workflow) from fan-out. trading-markets has no dedicated single slice prefix, so slices 111-114/120 share it by domain (medium confidence).

112.note: Portfolio and Risk Analytics — trading-markets domain (shared)

114.note: Broker Order Routing / Trade Execution — money-dense trading caps

slices._other_backlog_note: The 'other', 'unclustered', 'cognition', 'erp-stock', and 'strategy' domains are intentionally NOT claimed by any slice yet — they are true-scope backlog, surfaced in their generated cap-roadmap docs. A future reconciliation re-domains the mis-clustered noise.* rows out of erp-finance; until then they appear in 030's backlog section, never silently.

_keyOverrides_note: REVIEWED per-key routing (confidence=high, reviewed=1). Resolves the trading-markets S112-vs-S114 split that domain-only matching left low-confidence: execution/money caps -> S114 (Broker Order Routing & Trade Execution); analytics/read caps -> S112 (Portfolio & Risk Analytics); genuinely mis-domained noise -> left to backlog (no slice). Each entry is hand-confirmed.
_keyBacklog_note: These trading-domain caps are genuinely NOT trading-execution/analytics — they were clustered into trading-markets by accident and belong in backlog (no slice link).
